summary: Full e2e test of the new AI document-import feature plus regression of existing screens. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_import.py (14 tests, 14 passed) covering POST /api/projects/import (multipart, 3 real PDFs ~14MB total), async polling of GET /api/import-jobs/{id} (job completed in ~85-90s, upload POST returned in ~6s), the generated project shape (property+elements, measures with U-values, readiness breakdown, completion=73 <=78, 23 itemsBeforeIssue, designPack present, no _id leakage), documents linking (GET /api/projects/{id}/documents) and byte-exact download (GET /api/documents/{id}/download returns 200, %PDF magic, size matches). Existing regression suite backend_test.py: 12/12 pass. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080, public URL): dashboard -> new-project-button -> /import; 3 PDFs uploaded into Assessment / Scope of Works / ASHP Survey slots each showing a 'Ready' chip; counter and clear-slot work; datasheets multi-file chips work; Generate showed the staged progress panel (all 6 stages), and after ~90s the app navigated to /project/RTF-2026-0169 showing '1 Marion Roberts Court', 73% readiness ring, correct client (Saffron Housing Trust) and 23 ITEMS BEFORE ISSUE with a 'Draft design generated' toast. Evidence section (nav-evidence) lists the linked docs with working download links (verified 200 / 4,749,564 bytes) and picks up datasheets added via POST /api/projects/{id}/documents. Regression OK: dashboard KPIs + 9/10 rows, RTF-2026-0142 overview, design workspace, measure-card-EWI (U 0.28 / PASS), design pack. Zero page errors / console errors across all runs. One real data-integrity defect found: documents from deleted projects get re-attached to newly imported projects because project ids/refs are reused.

critical.issue: Project ref is used as the primary key AND is derived from a live count: next_ref() = 'RTF-2026-{160+count}'. Because ids are reused after projects are deleted (e.g. POST /api/reseed deletes projects but NOT db.documents), a newly imported project inherits ALL documents of the previously deleted project with the same ref. Reproduced: /api/projects/RTF-2026-0168/documents and .../RTF-2026-0169/documents each return 6 docs (a.pdf/s.pdf/h.pdf from the agent's earlier curl runs + my 3), and the Evidence UI visibly lists 3 unrelated PDFs. Same root cause can make the import job fail with DuplicateKeyError on insert_one (doc['_id']=project['id']) whenever the count-derived ref already exists -> job status 'error'. Fix: use a uuid for project id (keep ref as a display field) and generate ref from a monotonic counter collection, not count_documents(); also cascade-delete documents on reseed.

minor.issue: Blocking sync I/O inside an async endpoint: put_object() uses requests.put (up to 8.9MB per file) and extract_pdf_text() runs pypdf synchronously. Both block the FastAPI event loop for several seconds per upload (measured ~6s for 3 files) and stall all concurrent requests. Wrap in asyncio.to_thread / run_in_executor. (Two GET requests timed out at 30s during a parallel run.)

If put_object fails the document row is still inserted with storage_path=None, so it is listed in the UI but has no download button and can never be recovered. Also, if the AI job errors, the uploaded document rows stay orphaned (project_id=None) forever - no cleanup.
Returns 200 [] for a non-existent project id instead of 404 (no project existence check).
Content-Disposition is 'inline' only - no attachment option, so the 'download' button opens the PDF in a tab rather than downloading. Cosmetic/UX.

calculatedU is returned identical to targetU for every fabric measure (LOFT 0.11/0.11, WIN 1.195/1.195, DOORS 1.3/1.3) - the model mirrors the target rather than calculating, so the 'Target U-value achieved' check always passes. Also epcBefore came back as the free-text sentence 'Not confirmed in documents' which renders awkwardly in the EPC field ('Not confirmed in documents -> A (94)'). Consider constraining these in the prompt or nulling calculatedU when it cannot be derived.

ui_bugs.issue: Lists stale documents belonging to a previously deleted project with the same ref (a.pdf/s.pdf/h.pdf shown on RTF-2026-0168 and RTF-2026-0169). Symptom of the backend id-reuse bug above, but user-visible as wrong evidence attached to a design.

The polling setInterval has no attempt cap or timeout. If the job never resolves (or the browser loses the job id on refresh) the user is stuck on the progress panel forever with no cancel/retry. Add a max wait (~3 min) + error state, and persist job_id (e.g. localStorage) so a refresh can resume.

The staged messages are driven by a fixed 4s timer, not real job progress, so all 6 stages finish long before the ~90s job does and the panel sits on the last stage for ~60s with no elapsed-time or reassurance beyond the static caption. Consider driving stages from job status or adding an elapsed timer.
checks = p.measures.flatMap(m => m.checks).slice(0,6) produces duplicate labels - 'Construction confirmed' is rendered twice in the Design Checks list on the imported project. De-duplicate by label.
No client-side file-type/size validation or feedback: accept only filters the picker, and 14MB of PDFs are uploaded with no progress indicator during the (blocking) POST.

issues: Disabled 'Generate Draft Design' button is white text on 40%-opacity blue - fails contrast and still reads as an enabled primary CTA; use a neutral/muted disabled style.
Large empty area below the cards at 1920x1080 - the 860px column leaves the page looking unfinished.

Long AI-extracted values overflow the 300px Project Intelligence rail: 'Cavity masonry (stretcher bond), 300mm total wall thickness' and 'Not confirmed in documents -> A (94)' run to the panel edge / wrap awkwardly. Truncate with a title tooltip or allow wrapping with padding.
Left-nav measure labels are truncated ('External Door Replacem...', 'Mechanical Extract ...') with no tooltip.

action_items: HIGH: Stop reusing project ids/refs. Use a uuid for project id and derive ref from a monotonic counter (not count_documents). Also delete db.documents (or its storage objects) in /api/reseed so stale evidence cannot be re-attached. Clean up the current DB: RTF-2026-0168/0169/0170 each carry unrelated a.pdf/s.pdf/h.pdf.
Move put_object() and extract_pdf_text() off the event loop (asyncio.to_thread) in both /projects/import and /projects/{id}/documents.
Add a polling timeout + cancel/retry to ImportProject.jsx and persist job_id so a page refresh can resume.
Fail the import (or flag it) when put_object fails instead of persisting a document row with storage_path=None; clean up orphaned document rows when a job errors.
Return 404 from GET /api/projects/{id}/documents for unknown project ids.
De-duplicate Design Checks labels in IntelligencePanel; fix disabled-button contrast on /import; handle long values in the 300px right rail.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py next_ref(): `160 + await db.projects.count_documents({})` is not a safe id generator - it is non-monotonic under deletion and racy under concurrent imports (two simultaneous imports get the same ref, and the second insert_one dies on the _id unique index, surfacing only as job status 'error').

server.py process_import_job(): doc['_id'] = project['id'] means the ref is the Mongo primary key; any ref collision is an unrecoverable 500-class failure for the job. Decouple _id/id from the human-readable ref.

server.py import_project(): sync requests.put and pypdf parsing inside `async def` block the event loop; also the whole file is read into memory (`await f.read()`) with no size limit - a large upload can OOM the pod.

server.py: fire-and-forget `asyncio.create_task(process_import_job(...))` holds no reference and has no persistence - jobs are lost on backend restart and the import_jobs row stays 'processing' forever (frontend then polls indefinitely).
server.py is 954 lines with seed data, storage client, AI prompt and routes in one module - split into seed/storage/ai/routes.
ImportProject.jsx generate(): the poll interval is never cleared on unmount, and the stage timer is not cleared when navigating away - leaks a setInterval per import attempt.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (import e2e, evidence/download, regression); 1 HIGH data-integrity defect surfaced in Evidence

Sample PDFs cached at /tmp/pdfs/{assessment,scope,ashp}.pdf. Run POST /api/reseed to restore the 8 seeded projects (note: this leaves document rows behind - see HIGH issue).

It needs the 3 sample PDFs at /tmp/pdfs/ (re-download from the URLs in the review request if the container was recycled). rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the wrong-evidence bug: server.py next_ref() returns f'RTF-2026-{160 + count_documents}' and process_import_job stores that ref as both project['id'] and Mongo _id, while documents are linked by project_id = that ref. /api/reseed deletes db.projects but never db.documents, so the ref counter resets and the next import re-mints an already-used ref, silently adopting the orphaned documents of the deleted project. Reproduce: POST /api/projects/import (creates RTF-2026-016N with 3 docs) -> POST /api/reseed -> POST /api/projects/import again -> GET /api/projects/RTF-2026-016N/documents returns 6 docs and the Evidence UI shows 3 documents that belong to a different design. Mitigation: uuid4 project id + monotonic ref counter + cascade delete of documents on reseed.
